description: Defines the AppGatewayImplementation class, which implements interfaces for app gateway resolution and configuration, including nested classes for dispatching responses and managing app IDs. Contains method declarations for configuration, resolution, event handling, and message sending within an app gateway plugin.

classes.name: AppGatewayImplementation
classes.description: Implements app gateway resolution and configuration interfaces, manages message dispatching, app ID registry, and event handling.

classes.name: RespondJob
classes.description: Handles asynchronous response dispatching, either returning messages via socket or launching delegate based on context.

classes.name: AppIdRegistry
classes.description: Manages mapping between connection IDs and app IDs with thread safety.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the app gateway with provided paths.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on context, origin, method, and parameters, producing a result.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the service shell.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the response, either via socket or delegate, based on context.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an app ID associated with a connection ID.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an app ID associated with a connection ID.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the app ID for a given connection ID.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Handles an event with given context, alias, event name, origin, and listen flag.

methods.name: ReturnMessageInSocket
methods.description: Sends a message payload through the socket if responder is available.

methods.name: ProcessComRpcRequest
methods.description: Processes a COM RPC request with context, alias, method, params, and origin.

methods.name: UpdateContext
methods.description: Updates the context with method, params, and origin.

methods.name: InternalResolutionConfigure
methods.description: Configures internal resolution with provided paths.

methods.name: SetupAppGatewayAuthenticator
methods.description: Sets up the app gateway authenticator.
